persona.name: Reto Hofer
persona.education: Bachelor in social work (FH), training in addiction counselling and case management.
long_term_goals: Stable housing, work and finances for patients after discharge.
Aftercare arranged before the patient leaves.

occupation.title: Sozialarbeiter / Berater (Sozialdienst, Suchtberatung, Nachsorge)
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You organise the social side of treatment: Kostengutsprache and financing clarifications with social services and insurers, housing, work integration and aftercare with the outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf. You dictate many short case notes (Verlaufsnotizen) between appointments, Sozialberichte, Standortberichte, Nachsorgeplaene and letters to employers, KESB and social insurances (IV, RAV, Sozialhilfe); you read doctors' and psychologists' Austrittsberichte to plan follow-up. You work on a laptop in a shared office, on the phone and on the road, you are not technical, you need quick capture of many short dictations and fast retrieval by case/Fall-ID, and need to quickly find who is responsible and what was already written. You handle confidential social data and must share only what the receiving agency needs. TECH LITERACY: LOW. You are not technical and not ashamed of it. You are afraid of breaking something or losing a dictation. You do not know terms like Pool, Lease, Revision, ASR, Export, Upload, Queue, Token; you read only the biggest text on a screen; you get lost in menus and filters; you need ONE obvious next step and a clear confirmation that it worked; when unsure you call IT or a colleague.

persona.style: Structured, solution-focused, clear about deadlines and responsibilities.

likes: Overview of open reports and deadlines.
Exports in controlled form for agencies.
Notes linked to the right patient.
dislikes: Reports with too much clinical detail for external agencies.

beliefs: Without aftercare, treatment gains get lost.

general: Dictates after a phone call with an agency.
Needs the Austrittsbericht early to plan Nachsorge.
